items.title: Intake Form Fields
items.note:
Priority 3 -- Ahmed's manual workaround already covers this, so nothing's actually stuck waiting on it.

Section 19 audit covered Maadi Law groups on all four boards. Intake Form Fields 12964344103 on CRM owns the required field policy for intake and its 3 September update already made phone the only required field on the GoHighLevel form, so this is the same decision applied to the website form and is drafted as an update on it. Minor HIPAA Condition, a subitem of Document Handling 12471736810, owns the document path Nacer and Ahmed explained in the chat, not form validation. Connect Forms to GHL under Website 12471110064 and Connecting Forms to GHL 12750039746 on Web + SEO are both Done and are the plumbing, not the field rules. Section 19b returned no match.

payload.updateBody:
Salam,

The intake team couldn't create an opportunity for a minor, because the website form won't submit without a phone number and minors don't have one. Ahmed's covering it manually for now, the contact gets created straight in GoHighLevel with no placeholder number, tagged minor, with the guardian kept as a separate contact for the documents. Our own required-field work already made phone the only required field on the GoHighLevel form itself, the public website form just never got the same change.

We need the phone field made optional on Maadi Law's website intake form so a minor can submit on name alone, the submission still reaching GoHighLevel on the same field mapping, and the minor tag still applying from the form. No placeholder numbers, a fake number on a minor's record routes the HIPAA and representation documents to the wrong place, which is exactly what the manual workaround exists to avoid.

Done: a minor can submit the website form with no phone number and the record lands in GoHighLevel correctly tagged.

@Ahmed Memon @Ali Shaheer

items.title: Lead Source Dashboard
items.note: Priority 3 -- real build the firm asked for, no deadline named, nothing blocked on it. Section 19 audit covered Maadi Law groups on all four boards, subitems included; section 19b found no pending queue match on any axis. No dashboard or cross channel reporting item exists for Maadi Law on any board (Ads Reports 12471077490 holds per channel ad reports only). Routed to Web + SEO per section 8 (reporting dashboards). Prerequisite check: GHL source values are not standardized yet, so that is sequenced as step 1.

payload.updateBody:
Salam,

  • On the 9/24 call Maadi Law asked for reporting outside GoHighLevel that shows where leads come from and how they convert. GoHighLevel's own reporting cannot answer that today because lead source values are inconsistent.
  • Step 1: agree one fixed list of source values (Meta, Google Ads, LSA, Google Business Profile, organic, referral) and make sure every intake path writes one of them to the GoHighLevel source field. Coordinate with Ahmed on the CRM side.
  • Step 2: build the dashboard pulling GoHighLevel, Google Business Profile, Meta Ads, Google Ads and LSA: leads by source, cost per lead, and pipeline stage reached per source. Include lead demographics where the data allows.
  • Do not start step 2 before step 1 is done, otherwise the dashboard reports the same bad source data.
  • Done when Sharif can see last month's leads split by source with cost and stage reached, without opening GoHighLevel.

@Muhammad Hashir Faiz @Zayan Faiz

items.title: Intake Call Drops
items.note: Priority 2 -- false missed calls distort reporting and trigger chases on leads the firm already spoke to. Section 19 audit covered Maadi Law groups on all four boards, subitems included; section 19b found no pending queue match on any axis. Intake Call Drops 13019178772 on CRM owns Maadi Law inbound call handling, so this is an update there. Related sibling card, not merged: maadilaw-lead-followup-stop-checks (the chase that fires after an IVR call) depends on calls being recorded as answered, which is what this fixes.

payload.updateBody:
Salam,

  • New from the 9/24 call: calls routed through the firm's Zoom IVR land in GoHighLevel as missed even when someone answered, so missed call alerts are firing on real conversations.
  • Add a call answer confirmation (a keypress before the call connects) so a call only counts as answered when a person picks up, and confirm it records correctly in GoHighLevel.
  • Scope rebuilding the IVR natively in GoHighLevel instead of Zoom, and post what it would take before building anything.
  • The lead follow up chase depends on this: once IVR calls record as answered, that chase can stop on a call.

@Ahmed Memon @Ali Shaheer

payload.updateBody:
Salam,

  • New from the 9/24 call: intake fields and notes sit on the GoHighLevel contact, so a client with two cases shares one set of case details and the wrong data reaches Clio.
  • Move case specific intake fields and notes to the opportunity, keeping only personal details on the contact, and point the Clio mapping at the opportunity fields.
  • Make date of incident mandatory on the opportunity, since the Clio sync needs it.
  • Test Send to Clio with a new contact and with one contact holding two opportunities. Each should create its own matter with its own notes and documents.
  • Ahmed to walk the firm through the document upload area, so Sharif can confirm uploads reach Dropbox and the Clio case.

payload.updateBody:
Salam,

  • On the 9/30 call Justice Consumer Law reviewed the case and settlement dashboard on Netlify, which pulls Zoho and Windsor data every two hours. They asked for the changes below.
  • Reconcile paid and unpaid counts. Zoho shows 82 paid and 13 unpaid cases, the dashboard shows 42 paid and 25 unpaid. Fix the year filter (case creation year vs payment year) and check the result against Zoho with Diana.
  • Rework Fees Collected in 2026 so it counts every payment received in 2026, including cases packaged in 2025 or earlier, not only the 278 cases packaged in 2026. Label it clearly.
  • Add pre suit and filed dates to the dashboard once the new Zoho custom fields exist.
  • Make each case clickable through to its Zoho record so the firm can verify and correct data directly.
  • Depends on the firm: Diana is auditing case stages (settled paid / unpaid) in Zoho and still enters payments monthly from Amy's accountant reports, so payment figures will lag until then. Andrew is only exploring payment import automation with Rocco, do not build it yet.

@Muhammad Hashir Faiz @Zayan Faiz
